=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Add and commit workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md as a symlink to ../CLAUDE.md. Verify the section-number test and release gate." (linked issue #6561, fix section; PR description says "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6561")
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md (a new tracked symlink to ../CLAUDE.md, plus a passing `pytest tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py::test_template_claude_md_is_the_same_file` at tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py:33-36 which asserts `(ROOT / "workflow-templates" / "CLAUDE.md").resolve() == CLAUDE_MD.resolve()`)
  Evidence of absence: a glob for `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` and `**/CLAUDE.md` from the repository root returns no such file (only the root `CLAUDE.md` exists); a grep across the repo for the path returns no tracked file. The PR's `pr_changed_files.txt` and `last_run_changed_files.txt` both list only `agents.md`, `changelog.d/6561-activation-verify-tracked-symlinks.md`, `prompts/_templates/mode-activation-verify.txt`, `prompts/mode-activation-verify.txt`, `scripts/activation_verify.sh`, and `tests/test_activation_verify.py` — none of them under `workflow-templates/`. The PR's own `agents.md` change, the new `changelog.d/6561-...md`, and both copies of `prompts/mode-activation-verify.txt` all describe the change as "the verifier now lists tracked symlinks so a tracked link such as `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` is never reported missing" — they describe a workaround for the false positive, not the addition of the symlink the issue asks for. `tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py:33-36` will fail on the branch: `Path("workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md").resolve()` resolves to `<ROOT>/workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` (no symlink, no target), which is not equal to `Path("CLAUDE.md").resolve()`. The release gate runs this test at `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4662-4675` (referenced by the issue itself) and `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:309-349` will skip the root-file sync, so the gate the issue asks to verify will not pass on this PR.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
